recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15921; future workflow-researchStudy or SearchParameter-workflow-researchStudy changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack and tracked through its publication process.
issue_request: FHIR-15921 is Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. The final resolution was to add a standard event/workflow researchStudy extension pointing to ResearchStudy, deprecate the older QuestionnaireResponse-specific extension, and define a standard search parameter; the work group decided not to add a ResearchSubject extension because ResearchSubject could be reached through existing Patient-based search paths.
initial_application: No current core commit explicitly mentions FHIR-15921. The current checkout's R4 history bundle contains workflow-researchStudy with event/resource contexts including QuestionnaireResponse, a workflow mapping to Event.researchStudy, and valueReference constrained to ResearchStudy. I did not find an active current core source file for the extension or its SearchParameter; later Jira/history shows the search support exists in R5+ through the moved Extension Pack artifact family.
additional_context: The authoritative workflow-researchStudy StructureDefinition and SearchParameter now live in HL7/fhir-extensions. Current core source only has OID entries and a macro-based narrative link for these artifacts, while the Extension Pack IG includes input/definitions/* and its current files define the researchStudy extension and SearchParameter. FHIR-13847, FHIR-33147, FHIR-39656, FHIR-41308, and FHIR-43174 are already represented on the combined branch and cover related ResearchSubject/search or later Extension Pack updates. FHIR-19717 later resolved No Change because R5 already had the extension and search parameter.
reconciliation: Made no core source change and published an empty external-repo audit commit. Reintroducing duplicate core definitions would be outside current build scope; any future artifact changes belong in HL7/fhir-extensions.
